items.source: Returns a WebMergedContextConfiguration if the test class in the supplied MergedContextConfiguration is annotated with @WebAppConfiguration and otherwise returns the supplied instance unmodified.
items.translation: 返回一个 `WebMergedContextConfiguration`，如果提供的 `MergedContextConfiguration` 中的测试类标注了 `@WebAppConfiguration`；否则返回未修改的提供实例。

items.source: Process the supplied, newly instantiated MergedContextConfiguration instance.
items.translation: 处理新实例化的MergedContextConfiguration 实例。

items.source: WebMergedContextConfiguration encapsulates the merged context configuration declared on a test class and all of its superclasses and enclosing classes via @ContextConfiguration, @WebAppConfiguration, @ActiveProfiles, and @TestPropertySource.
items.translation: WebMergedContextConfiguration 封装了测试类及其所有父类和包含类上声明的*合并*上下文配置，这些配置通过@ContextConfiguration、@WebAppConfiguration、@ActiveProfiles和@TestPropertySource注解声明。

items.source: Load a GenericApplicationContext for AOT run-time execution based on the supplied MergedContextConfiguration and ApplicationContextInitializer.
items.translation: 基于提供的 MergedContextConfiguration 和 ApplicationContextInitializer，为 AOT 运行时执行加载一个 GenericApplicationContext。

items.source: Load a GenericWebApplicationContext for AOT run-time execution based on the supplied MergedContextConfiguration and ApplicationContextInitializer.
items.translation: 基于提供的 MergedContextConfiguration 和 ApplicationContextInitializer，为 AOT 运行时加载一个 GenericWebApplicationContext。

items.source: Load a new ApplicationContext based on the supplied MergedContextConfiguration, configure the context, and return the context in a fully refreshed state.
items.translation: 加载一个新的基于提供的MergedContextConfiguration的ApplicationContext，配置该上下文，并以完全刷新的状态返回该上下文。

items.source: Customize the ConfigurableApplicationContext created by this ContextLoader after bean definitions have been loaded into the context but before the context has been refreshed.
items.translation: 自定义由该`ContextLoader` 在将 Bean 定义加载到上下文后但在刷新上下文之前创建的ConfigurableApplicationContext。

items.source: Load bean definitions into the supplied context from the locations in the supplied MergedContextConfiguration using a GroovyBeanDefinitionReader.
items.translation: 从提供的 `MergedContextConfiguration` 中的位置，使用 `GroovyBeanDefinitionReader` 将 bean 定义加载到提供的 `context` 中。

items.source: Register classes in the supplied context from the classes in the supplied MergedContextConfiguration.
items.translation: 在提供的context中注册类，这些类来自提供的MergedContextConfiguration。

items.source: Load a GenericApplicationContext for the supplied MergedContextConfiguration.
items.translation: 为提供的 MergedContextConfiguration 加载一个 GenericApplicationContext。

items.source: Load a GenericApplicationContext for AOT build-time processing based on the supplied MergedContextConfiguration.
items.translation: 基于提供的MergedContextConfiguration加载一个GenericApplicationContext，用于 AOT 构建时处理。

items.source: Prepare the ConfigurableApplicationContext created by this SmartContextLoader before bean definitions are read.
items.translation: 在读取 Bean 定义之前，准备由该 SmartContextLoader 创建的 ConfigurableApplicationContext。

items.source: Ensure that the supplied MergedContextConfiguration does not contain locations.
items.translation: 确保提供的MergedContextConfiguration不包含locations。

items.source: Ensure that the supplied MergedContextConfiguration does not contain classes.
items.translation: 确保提供的MergedContextConfiguration不包含classes。

items.source: Load a GenericWebApplicationContext for the supplied MergedContextConfiguration.
items.translation: 为提供的MergedContextConfiguration加载一个GenericWebApplicationContext。

items.source: Load a GenericWebApplicationContext for AOT build-time processing based on the supplied MergedContextConfiguration.
items.translation: 基于提供的MergedContextConfiguration加载一个用于 AOT 构建时处理的GenericWebApplicationContext。

items.source: Build the merged context configuration for the test class in the BootstrapContext associated with this bootstrapper.
items.translation: 为此引导器关联的 BootstrapContext 中的测试类构建合并上下文配置。

items.source: Load bean definitions into the supplied context from the locations or classes in the supplied MergedContextConfiguration.
items.translation: 从提供的 `MergedContextConfiguration` 中的位置或类加载到提供的 context 中。

items.source: Delegates to an appropriate candidate SmartContextLoader to load an ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 委托给适当的候选`SmartContextLoader`来加载一个ApplicationContext。

items.source: Delegates to an appropriate candidate SmartContextLoader to load an ApplicationContext for AOT run-time execution.
items.translation: 委托给适当的候选 `SmartContextLoader` 来加载一个 `ApplicationContext`，用于 AOT 运行时执行。

items.source: since 6.1 in favor of MergedContextConfiguration(Class, String[], Class[], Set, String[], List, String[], Set, ContextLoader, CacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate, MergedContextConfiguration)
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，推荐使用 MergedContextConfiguration(Class, String[], Class[], Set, String[], List, String[], Set, ContextLoader, CacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate, MergedContextConfiguration)
自 Spring Framework 6.2.4 起，推荐使用 AotContextLoader.loadContextForAotProcessing(MergedContextConfiguration, RuntimeHints)； 将在 Spring Framework 8.0 中移除。

items.source: since Spring Framework 7.0 in favor of ContextCache.put(MergedContextConfiguration, LoadFunction)
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 7.0 起，推荐使用 ContextCache.put(MergedContextConfiguration, LoadFunction)
自 Spring Framework 6.2.4 起，推荐使用 AbstractDelegatingSmartContextLoader.loadContextForAotProcessing(MergedContextConfiguration, RuntimeHints)； 将在 Spring Framework 8.0 中移除。
自 Spring Framework 6.2.4 起，推荐使用AbstractGenericContextLoader.loadContextForAotProcessing(MergedContextConfiguration, RuntimeHints)；将在 Spring Framework 8.0 中移除。
自 Spring Framework 6.2.4 起，推荐使用 AbstractGenericWebContextLoader.loadContextForAotProcessing(MergedContextConfiguration, RuntimeHints)； 将在 Spring Framework 8.0 中移除。

items.source: since 6.1 in favor of WebMergedContextConfiguration(Class, String[], Class[], Set, String[], List, String[], Set, String, ContextLoader, CacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate, MergedContextConfiguration)
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，推荐使用 WebMergedContextConfiguration(Class, String[], Class[], Set, String[], List, String[], Set, String, ContextLoader, CacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate, MergedContextConfiguration)

items.source: Get the MergedContextConfiguration for the parent application context in a context hierarchy.
items.translation: 在上下文层次结构中获取父应用程序上下文的MergedContextConfiguration。

items.source: Validate the supplied MergedContextConfiguration with respect to what this context loader supports.
items.translation: 验证提供的MergedContextConfiguration是否符合此上下文加载器的支持范围。

items.source: Uses of MergedContextConfiguration in org.springframework.test.context
items.translation: `org.springframework.test.context` 包中 `MergedContextConfiguration` 的用法

items.source: Uses of MergedContextConfiguration in org.springframework.test.context.aot
items.translation: `MergedContextConfiguration` 在 `org.springframework.test.context.aot` 中的用法

items.source: Uses of MergedContextConfiguration in org.springframework.test.context.cache
items.translation: `MergedContextConfiguration` 在 `org.springframework.test.context.cache` 中的用法

items.source: Uses of MergedContextConfiguration in org.springframework.test.context.support
items.translation: `org.springframework.test.context.support` 包中 `MergedContextConfiguration` 的用法

items.source: Uses of MergedContextConfiguration in org.springframework.test.context.web
items.translation: `MergedContextConfiguration` 在 `org.springframework.test.context.web` 中的用法

items.source: Remove the application context for the supplied MergedContextConfiguration from the ContextCache and close it if it is an instance of ConfigurableApplicationContext.
items.translation: 从ContextCache中移除为提供的MergedContextConfiguration创建的application context，如果它是ConfigurableApplicationContext的实例，则调用其close()方法。

items.source: Load the application context for the supplied MergedContextConfiguration by delegating to the ContextLoader configured in the given MergedContextConfiguration.
items.translation: 加载由给定 `MergedContextConfiguration` 中配置的 `ContextLoader` 委托加载的、为提供的 `MergedContextConfiguration` 指定的 `application context`。

items.source: Load a new ApplicationContext for AOT run-time execution based on the supplied MergedContextConfiguration and ApplicationContextInitializer.
items.translation: 基于提供的 MergedContextConfiguration 和 ApplicationContextInitializer，为 AOT 运行时加载一个新的 ApplicationContext。

items.source: Load a new ApplicationContext based on the supplied MergedContextConfiguration and return the context in a fully refreshed state.
items.translation: 加载一个新的基于提供的 MergedContextConfiguration 的 ApplicationContext，并以完全刷新的状态返回该上下文。

items.source: Determine if the application context for the supplied MergedContextConfiguration has been loaded (i.e., is present in the ContextCache).
items.translation: 确定已为提供的MergedContextConfiguration加载了application context（即，它是否存在于ContextCache中）。

items.source: Register usage of the application context for the supplied MergedContextConfiguration as well as usage of the application context for its parent, recursively.
items.translation: 注册为提供的MergedContextConfiguration使用的application context，以及为其parent递归地注册 application context 的使用。

items.source: Unregister usage of the application context for the supplied MergedContextConfiguration as well as usage of the application context for its parent, recursively.
items.translation: 注销为提供的MergedContextConfiguration注册的application context的使用，以及为其parent的 application context 的使用（递归地）。

items.source: Load a new ApplicationContext for AOT build-time processing based on the supplied MergedContextConfiguration, configure the context, and return the context.
items.translation: 基于提供的MergedContextConfiguration加载一个新的用于 AOT 构建时处理的ApplicationContext，配置上下文并返回该上下文。

items.source: Register usage of the ApplicationContext for the supplied MergedContextConfiguration and any of its parents.
items.translation: 注册为提供的 MergedContextConfiguration 及其任何父级使用的 ApplicationContext。

items.source: Unregister usage of the ApplicationContext for the supplied MergedContextConfiguration and any of its parents.
items.translation: 取消注册为提供的 MergedContextConfiguration 及其任何父级注册的 ApplicationContext 的使用。

items.source: Customize the supplied ConfigurableApplicationContext after bean definitions have been loaded into the context but before the context has been refreshed.
items.translation: 在将 bean 定义加载到上下文之后但在刷新上下文之前，自定义提供的 `ConfigurableApplicationContext`。

items.source: Delegates to an appropriate candidate SmartContextLoader to load an ApplicationContext for AOT processing.
items.translation: 委托给适当的候选`SmartContextLoader`以加载用于 AOT 处理的ApplicationContext。

items.source: Create a new MergedContextConfiguration instance by copying all fields from the supplied MergedContextConfiguration.
items.translation: 通过复制提供的 `MergedContextConfiguration` 的所有字段来创建一个新的 `MergedContextConfiguration` 实例。

items.source: Obtain a cached ApplicationContext for the given key.
items.translation: 获取给定键的缓存的ApplicationContext。

items.source: Explicitly add an ApplicationContext to the cache under the given key, potentially honoring a custom eviction policy.
items.translation: 在给定键下的缓存中显式添加一个ApplicationContext，可能会遵守自定义的驱逐策略。

items.source: Remove the context with the given key from the cache and explicitly close it if it is an instance of ConfigurableApplicationContext.
items.translation: 从缓存中移除具有给定键的上下文，如果它是 `ConfigurableApplicationContext` 的实例，则显式关闭它。

items.source: Create a new WebMergedContextConfiguration instance by copying all properties from the supplied MergedContextConfiguration.
items.translation: 通过复制提供的 `MergedContextConfiguration` 的所有属性来创建一个新的 `WebMergedContextConfiguration` 实例。

items.source: This package contains the Spring TestContext Framework which provides annotation-driven unit and integration testing support that is agnostic of the actual testing framework in use.
items.translation: 该包包含Spring TestContext 框架，它提供与所使用的实际测试框架无关的基于注解的单元测试和集成测试支持。

items.source: Ahead-of-time (AOT) support for the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: Spring TestContext Framework 的提前编译（AOT）支持。

items.source: Support for context caching within the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: 支持在Spring TestContext Framework中的上下文缓存。

items.source: Support classes for the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: 支持Spring TestContext Framework的类。

items.source: Web support classes for the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: Spring TestContext Framework 的 Web 支持类。

items.source: Create a new MergedContextConfiguration instance for the supplied parameters.
items.translation: 创建一个新的MergedContextConfiguration实例，使用提供的参数。

items.source: Create a new MergedContextConfiguration instance for the supplied parameters.
items.translation: 为提供的参数创建一个新的MergedContextConfiguration实例。

items.source: Load the ApplicationContext for the supplied merged context configuration.
items.translation: 加载为提供的合并上下文配置加载的ApplicationContext。

items.source: Construct a new DefaultTestContext from the supplied arguments.
items.translation: 从提供的参数构建一个新的DefaultTestContext。

items.source: Create a new WebMergedContextConfiguration instance for the supplied parameters.
items.translation: 为提供的参数创建一个新的WebMergedContextConfiguration实例。

items.source: Determine whether there is a cached context for the given key.
items.translation: 确定给定键是否存在缓存上下文。

items.source: Get the failure count for the given key.
items.translation: 获取给定键的失败次数。

items.source: Increment the failure count for the given key.
items.translation: 递增给定键的失败计数。
